summary: Prepare traceable AFOLU project evidence, field records and review responses. Explore the course outline and practical exercises.
lede: Carbon project MRV and verification readiness training helps AFOLU teams prepare project records for independent review. For project developers, MRV officers, donor programme officers and environmental consultants, it covers mapping claims to criteria, tracing monitoring data to source records, and assessing field evidence. Participants also develop evidence registers and field logs, document responses to review findings, and prepare readiness briefs while leaving independent verification decisions to appropriately authorized VVBs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, manage or review AFOLU carbon-project records and need to make the evidence trail easier to assess. It suits intermediate practitioners with some exposure to project monitoring, environmental evidence or carbon documentation.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with carbon-project monitoring, environmental project records or MRV documentation is recommended. No VVB credential is required; course completion does not provide VVB accreditation or authorization to conduct independent verification. Coding is not required.
